steps.what: Monitor patients through examination, symptom discussion and review of clinical progress
Reevaluate treatments using the current assessment and discuss necessary changes

tasks.design: Keep monitoring and treatment reevaluation with the clinician. Native clinical record views in {OTHER} can display observations without replacing assessment or earning a saving for runtime.
tasks.previous_blocker: Clinical progress depends on examination, changing symptoms and interpretation of incomplete information.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical record systems can display results; that does not automate treatment judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Subtle deterioration and competing treatment risks require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician integrates examination, patient preferences and uncertainty.
tasks.altitude: Clinical work and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Coordinate observations and escalation during pregnancy care

evidence.claim: Displaying clinical observations does not by itself replace examination or treatment reevaluation; no automation saving is established for these steps.

assumptions: Boundary covers the physician's monitoring and treatment reevaluation, not separate record writing, laboratory testing or medication dispensing.
The physician produces current clinical assessment in s1 using direct observations and existing records. There is no assumed structured deterioration, stability or treatment-eligibility flag.

OTHER denotes the clinical record system; test native display configuration before proposing custom code. Existing results originate with their existing clinical producers and are not claimed as savings here.
No new tool or workflow is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero. Assessment and treatment discussion keep their full time.
unknowns: Clinical setting and existing observation display
Responsibilities for monitoring between physician contacts
research_questions: Is there separately measurable record navigation work that can improve without reducing clinical assessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 minus0 upkeep =net0. Stable follow-up and uncertain deterioration both retain assessment and reevaluation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Consult with other physicians to interpret cases and agree clinical advice

tasks.design: Preserve physician consultation as a clinical conversation. Existing case information in the clinical record {OTHER} supports discussion without automatically producing advice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Consultation resolves case-specific uncertainty through professional discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Record access can support an informed conversation but does not establish a replacement for it.
tasks.still_hard: Different interpretations, urgency and incomplete findings require reciprocal discussion.
tasks.human_edge: Physicians challenge assumptions and accept responsibility for their advice.
tasks.altitude: Consultation remains part of the physician's week with unchanged authority.

reach.task: Clarify referral questions and shared care responsibilities
reach.learn: Concise clinical handover and uncertainty communication

evidence.claim: Case-specific physician consultation remains a judgement-based conversation; documentation assistance is a separate opportunity.

assumptions: Boundary is the focal physician's consultation, excluding a separate referral letter or post-consultation note. Colleague time is not counted as focal-role time or a saving.
Physicians bring the clinical question and observations to the conversation; no automatically validated case summary is assumed.
OTHER denotes the clinical record system. Native record access should be tested before adding retrieval or drafting software.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new consultation system is introduced.
unknowns: Consultation modes and information access across organizations
research_questions: Does missing case information create a distinct preparation task worth measuring?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Brief routine consultations and complex multidisciplinary discussions both retain physician judgement.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct and coordinate medical staff through clinical prioritization, delegation and supervision

tasks.design: Keep clinical direction and supervision with the physician. A care task list in the clinical record {OTHER} may support coordination without deciding delegation or removing bedside supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Staff direction combines changing care priorities with individual competence and workload.
tasks.enabler_now: Task lists make existing responsibilities visible but do not perform clinical supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Emergencies and ambiguous responsibilities require immediate judgement and communication.
tasks.human_edge: The physician recognizes when delegation is unsuitable and supports staff learning.
tasks.altitude: Clinical leadership and its time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Team situational awareness and closed-loop communication

evidence.claim: A task list can support coordination but does not replace clinical delegation and supervision.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical direction and supervision, excluding workforce rota administration and work performed by directed staff.
The physician assesses care needs and staff capabilities during the work; no structured safe-to-delegate flag is assumed.
OTHER denotes the clinical record system. Check native task visibility before any custom tool; no extra recording or staff monitoring is proposed.
No changed system or workflow means zero incremental upkeep. No staff effort is transferred or claimed as a physician saving.
unknowns: Existing delegation arrangements and care task visibility
research_questions: Is any repeated coordination paperwork separable from direct clinical supervision?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Routine coordination and urgent reprioritization retain direct clinical leadership.

tasks.short: Advise patients and communities on prevention

steps.what: Advise patients and community members about diet, activity, hygiene and disease prevention

tasks.design: Keep individualized advice and understanding checks in the clinical conversation. Use approved information in {DOCS} as a supporting reference before considering any generated explanation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice must account for clinical context, preferences and ability to act on it.
tasks.enabler_now: Vetted patient information already exists and can support the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Personal relevance, uncertainty and barriers to prevention require dialogue.
tasks.human_edge: The clinician adapts advice, checks understanding and recognizes concerns beyond the stated question.
tasks.altitude: Patient and community advice retains its current time and clinical authority.

reach.task: Explain prevention and self-care during pregnancy

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information; this supports references rather than automated individualized advice.
The proposed unchanged conversation has no measured labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the advice conversation and checking understanding, not separate production of public education materials.
The physician interprets questions and clinical context directly. No structured recommendation eligibility is assumed or consumed by automation.
Use native document search and existing approved information first. Clinical information owners continue their existing content maintenance; this design adds no work for them.
Zero incremental upkeep because no new model, content service or workflow is introduced.
research_questions: Is repeated information lookup a distinct measured burden without reducing advice and understanding checks?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 upkeep0 net0. Brief prevention questions and complex personal barriers both retain the clinical conversation.
